simple.meaning: צֶדֶק (tsedeq) appears 119 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Job, Psalms, Proverbs, and 2 more, beginning at Leviticus 19:15. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, righteousness, land, mountain, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צֶדֶק (H6664) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows צֶדֶק through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: צֶדֶק (tsedeq) / H6664 is tracked through Leviticus 19:15, Leviticus 19:36, Deuteronomy 1:16, Deuteronomy 16:18. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.full: H6664. tsedeq צֶ֫דֶק noun masculine Isa 1:21 rightness, righteousness ; — ׳צ Lev 19:36 87t.; צִדְקִי Isa 41:10 8 t., etc.; — 1 what is right, just, normal; rightness, justness , of weights and measures, וָצֶדֶק שְׁלֵמָה אֶבֶן אֵיפָה, Deut 25:15 a perfect and a just weight, ephah ; צ ׳מאֹזְנֵי ; צ ׳בַּת צ, ׳הִין צ, ׳אֵיפַת צ, ׳אַבְנֵי Lev 19:36 (H) Job 31:6 ; Ezek 45:10 ; צ ׳מַעְגְּלֵי right paths Psa 23:3 ; צ ׳זִבְחֵי right peace-offerings Deut 33:19 ; Psa 4:6 ; Psalm 51:21. 2 righteousness , in government: a. of judges, rulers, kings , בצ ׳שׁפט Lev 19:15 (H); צ ׳שׁפט Deut 1:16 ; Prov 31:9 ; צ ׳משׁפט Deut 16:18 ; צ ׳רדף 16:20 ; צ ׳חוֺקֵק Prov 8:15 ; לצ ׳מלך Isa 32:1 ; צ ׳דבּר Psa 58:2 ; also Prov 25:5 ; Psa 94:15 ; Eccl 5:7 . b. of law, as מִשְׁמָּטִים Isa 58:2 ; Psa 119:7 ; 119:62 ; 119:75 ; 119:106 ; 119:160 ( ᵐ5 , but מִשְׁמַּט ᵑ0 ), 119:164 ; as עֵדוֺת 119:138 ; 119:144 ; as מִצְוֺר 119:172 . c. of Davidic king, Messiah Isa 11:4-5 , 16:5 ; Psa 45:5 , דצ ׳דין 72:2 . d. of Jerusalem, as seat of just government , הַצֶּדֶק עִיר Isa 1:26 city of righteousness ; צ ׳נְוֵה Jer 31:23 ; 50:7 (possibly these reflect an original god צֶדֶק , see צֶדֶק מַלְכִּי ); ׳צ בָּהּ יָלִין Isa 1:21 righteousness used to lodge in her ; compare הצ ׳מְקוֺם Eccl 3:16 the place of righteousness. e. of God's attribute as sovereign Job 36:3 , husband of Israel Hosea 2:21 ; ׳צ his personified agent Psa 85:11 ; 85:12 ; Psalm 85:14, foundation of his throne 89:15 = 97:2 ; in his government 9:9 ; 65:6 ; 96:13 = 98:9 , promise Isa 45:19 , administration of justice Job 8:3 ; Jer 11:20 ; Psalm 7:18; Psa 48:11 ; 50:6 = 97:6 , vindication of his people 9:5 ; 35:24 ; 35:28 ; raising up Cyrus Isa 45:13 , calling his servant 42:6 ; צִדְקִי אֱלֹהֵי Psa 4:2 God of my righteousness (who vindicates me); his ׳צ is everlasting 119:142 . 3 righteousness, justice , in a case or cause Job 6:29 ; 8:6 ; 29:14 ; Psa 35:27 ; Isa 59:4 ; God כצ ׳שׁפט Psa 7:9 judges according to righteousness ; כצ ׳גמל 18:21 ; כצ ׳השׁיב 18:25 ; צ ׳שׁמע 17:1 צ ׳הוציא 37:6 . 4 rightness , in speech, צ ׳דבּר Psa 52:5 (opposed to שֶׁקֶר ); צ ׳יַגִּיד Prov 12:17 ; ׳בצ פי אמרי כל 8:8 ; צ ׳שִׂפְתֵי 16:13 . 5 righteousness , as ethically right Job 35:2 ; Psa 17:15 ; 45:8 ; Prov 1:3 ; 2:9 ; Eccl 7:15 ; Jer 22:13 ; Ezek 3:20 ; Hosea 10:12 (read צ ׳מְּרִי , so ᵐ5 We Now); עלמים׳צ Dan 9:24 ; צ ׳עשׂה Isa 64:4 ; Psa 119:121 ; צ ׳פעל 15:2 ; צ ׳למד Isa 26:6 , 10 ; צ ׳בקּשׁ Zeph 2:3 ; צ ׳רדף Isa 51:1 ; צ ׳ידע 51:7 . 6 righteousness as vindicated, justification in controversy with enemies and troubles, deliverance, victory, prosperity: a. of God as covenant-keeping, in redemption , צִדְקִי בִּימִין Isa 41:10 , || יֵשַׁע 45:8 ; 51:5 , compare 42:21 ; צ ׳בשּׂר Psa 40:10 ; צ ׳אִמְרַת 119:123 . b. in name צִדְקֵנוּ יהוה , of Messianic king (vindicating people's cause and giving victory) Jer 23:6 ; of city 33:16 . c. of people as enjoying ׳צ of salvation, || יְשׁוּעָה Isa 62:1 ; || כָּבוֺד 58:8 ; 62:2 ; צ יִלְבְּשׁוּ ׳כהנים Psa 132:9 ; צ ׳שַׁעֲרֵי 118:19 ; הצ ׳אֵילֵי Isa 61:3 . d. of Cyrus , ׳צ לְרַגְלוֺ יִקְרָאֵהוּ Isa 41:2 (who) in victory calleth him at every step (Che Hpt on whose steps attends victory , so Di Du).
